profile.name: Racal 1992频率计数器
profile.description: Racal 1992频率计数器，用于测量输入信号的频率，并支持预置、端口选择以及本地/远程控制切换，适用于电子与仪器实验中的频率测量。
profile.description_en: The Racal 1992 is a frequency counter used to measure the frequency of input signals. It supports preset, port selection, and switching between local and remote control for frequency measurement in electronics and instrumentation labs.
